def below_zero (operations : List Int) (h_precond : below_zero_precond (operations)) : (Array Int × Bool) :=
  let rec acc (ops : List Int) (sum : Int) : (List Int × Bool) :=
    match ops with
    | [] => ([], false)
    | op :: rest =>
        let next_sum := sum + op
        let (rest_lists, has_neg) := acc rest next_sum
        (next_sum :: rest_lists, if has_neg ∨ next_sum < 0 then true else false)
  let (partial_sums_list, has_neg) := acc operations 0
  let s := partial_sums_list.toArray
  (s, has_neg)
